variables.justification: Primary thermodynamic driver of vegetation desiccation, fine dead fuel equilibrium moisture content, and atmospheric fire weather severity.

Required together with 2m_temperature to calculate relative humidity (RH) and vapor pressure deficit (VPD) via August-Roche-Magnus approximation. VPD is the single most predictive atmospheric moisture stress indicator for live fuel flammability.
Orthogonal eastward wind component; combined with v10 to compute scalar horizontal wind speed (m/s) and meteorological wind direction azimuth (deg) along mountain valleys.
Orthogonal northward wind component; combined with u10 to determine wind velocity vectors that dictate rate of forward fire spread and smoke advection.

variables.transformation: mm = delta_m * 1000.0 (subject to diagnostic verification of 00:00 UTC accumulation cycle)
variables.justification: Direct ground moisture replenishment and fire extinction mechanism; critical for calculating antecedent drought indices (1-day, 3-day, 7-day, 14-day cumulative rainfall).
Surface litter and duff layer moisture memory; directly controls ignitability of pine needle litter (Chir Pine / Pinus roxburghii) and fine dead herbaceous matter.
Shallow rooting zone; controls physiological hydration and wilting point of understory vegetation, grasses, and shrubs that act as ladder fuels.
Deep root zone; establishes seasonal drought legacy for mature forest canopy (e.g., Shorea robusta / Sal forests), preventing or exacerbating crown fires during pre-monsoon heatwaves.
Subsoil hydrological reservoir; maintains multi-month regional hydrological memory and baseflow sustaining riparian moisture buffers.

excluded_variables_rationale.surface_pressure: Excluded from CDS request because in rugged mountain terrain (129m to 7804m), surface pressure is overwhelmingly (>98%) a monotonic barometric function of terrain elevation. Static 30m DEM elevation captures this topographic control with 300x higher spatial resolution than 0.1° ERA5-Land without wasting download bandwidth or CDS quota.
excluded_variables_rationale.surface_net_solar_radiation: Excluded from CDS request because 0.1° (~9 km) radiation fails to resolve ridge shadowing, aspect-dependent insolation, and steep slope lighting in Himalayan valleys. Topographic solar exposure is calculated directly from 30m DEM slope and circular aspect.
excluded_variables_rationale.boundary_layer_height: Excluded because boundary layer estimations in steep valleys have high reanalysis uncertainty and provide marginal incremental predictive power compared to VPD and 10m wind.
